benchmark: CDVQA Ground-Truth Semantic Oracle Evaluation (Yuan et al. 2022 Section II)
provenance: SECOND semantic labels (label1, label2) directly queried via algorithmic formulas in Section II
description: Tests whether CDVQA ground-truth answers can be derived directly from the SECOND semantic masks without any visual perception model.

results.oracle_derivation_summary: Yes. Section II of Yuan et al. (2022) details deterministic template-based rules applied to SECOND semantic change maps (s_t1, s_t2 in {0..6}). When these exact formulas are evaluated directly on the ground-truth masks, the Oracle achieves 99.94% Overall Accuracy and 99.89% Average Accuracy. Residual minor discrepancies occur due to edge-case template phrasings and bin boundary conventions.
